name: ci-preflight
description: Runs the fast CI checks (scripts/ci/preflight.sh) before a git push leaves the session; guards update-branch against failing or still-running checks; nudges when pushes to one branch come within 10 minutes; after a push, labels the open PR with its risk tier (tier:T0, tier:T1, tier:T1-strict, tier:T2; LCH-615, labels only).
